tldr: At critical Gaussian study precision, the extreme quantile of true study-specific treatment effects has uniform sharp original-record risk and globally honest connected-length limits on the declared nonparametric benchmark. The worst nuisance corner is \(c=1/2,\sigma=2\). An executed rational finite program at \((\alpha,\kappa)=(3/2,1)\) certifies \(C_R\in[3/1024,71/40]\) and \(C_L\in[11/2560,1219/200]\); the remaining widths are \(9073/5120\) and \(77961/12800\). These are coarse enclosures, not precise numerical values. The arbitrary-accuracy certification theorem and the nuisance-estimated, exactly finite-sample honest attainment theorem are distinct from this executed numerical branch. The separate oracle comparison concerns the defined Morozov specialization within this benchmark, not the published theorem under its own hypotheses. \cite{Morozov2026}
